rationale: Each tab loads withdrawal receipts once then writes a whole stale array. A later write by another tab can erase a receipt, preventing the posting browser from withdrawing an accepted record. The receipt storage listener only renders the in-memory list rather than synchronizing it. This is a withdrawal-capability/privacy issue.
